title: Release Gate Validation Run v1
description: A single validation run entry. Stored as JSONL entries in the validation run ledger. Each run references one or more phases and captures command, result, test classifications, and evidence.

command.description: The command that was executed for this validation run.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the validation run in seconds, if known.

tests_run.description: Number of tests executed in this run.

test_classifications.description: Test classification counts keyed by classification label (e.g., unit, contract, integration, e2e, real_artifact, adversarial, sabotage, concurrency, substrate).

schema_validation_results.description: Schema validation results keyed by schema path, with pass/fail/skip status.

evidence_paths.description: Paths to evidence artifacts produced by this run.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA when this validation run was executed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when validation run was created.
